about: Suggested urban farm land on this lot for each layout placed here (the lot minus the building, plant yard, at-grade plant with a 3.0 m clear band, truck court, truck drive and public front garden; pieces under 3.0 m wide dropped). Area only: no heat, no yield, not in any total. In each layout’s own layout frame (metres, as its storeys). Sources: City of Vancouver Zoning and Development By-law, I-2, I-3 and M-2 district schedules (s. 2.1, 2.2.1) and Section 11 (11.1.2.1, 11.1.2.6).
